spokenMeaning: The monologue names the exhausting behavior: bending yourself so everyone will like you.
viewerTakeaway: Trying to please everyone costs real pieces of yourself and never buys the approval back.
visualMechanism: depletion — the teal self-disc loses material that converts into gold approva...

visualNarrative.action: A solid teal circle labelled DIRI LU fades in intact, slightly left of center.
visualNarrative.meaning: Establishes the whole self before the eroding begins.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Unbroken teal disc with a full ring stroke, label 'DIRI LU' beneath it.

visualNarrative.action: Small gold notches break off the disc's right edge one by one, each becoming a gold coin token.
visualNarrative.meaning: Each attempt to please spends a real piece of the self.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Disc edge visibly dented where notches detached; coins emerge only from those notches.

visualNarrative.action: The gold coins drift along a thin arc toward three dim hollow face dots on the right.
visualNarrative.meaning: Self-material is converted into approval offerings sent outward.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Coin arc ends at a row of dim outlined faces, never curving back.

visualNarrative.action: Coins land; the faces stay dim and unresponsive while the teal disc is left as a thin hollow ring.
visualNarrative.meaning: Approval never returns — the effort depletes the giver permanently.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Hollow ring with wide empty center, label now dimmed, faces unchanged.

subtitlePlan.text: Berusaha… biar semua orang suka sama kita.
subtitlePlan.timing: spoken over the intact teal circle, before chipping begins

motionBeats.action: Fade-in and slight scale-up of the intact teal disc with its label
motionBeats.purpose: Present the whole self so its later loss is measurable

motionBeats.action: Staggered chipping: three notches detach at 0.5s intervals, each morphing into a coin
motionBeats.purpose: Show depletion as accumulated discrete acts, not a single event

motionBeats.action: Coins slide along the arc with soft ease-out toward the faces
motionBeats.purpose: Trace where the self-material actually goes

motionBeats.action: Coin arrival leaves faces static while the disc contracts to a hollow ring
motionBeats.purpose: Prove the exchange is one-way — effort converts to loss, not approval

motionBeats.action: Dim the DIRI LU label color as the ring hollows
motionBeats.purpose: Mark the identity cost as the scene's closing beat

compositionIntent: Centered mechanism on a dark radial stage: hollowing teal disc at ~35% x, three dim face dots at ~72% x, one thin gold arc connecting them, headline top-left in the upper third. Roughly 60% negative space, one text block plus one dominant object.
visualEvidence: Disc edge shows visible notches exactly where coins were removed, proving material left the self
Arc terminates at the audience with no return line, proving the giving is one-way
Faces remain the same dim outline after receiving three coins, proving approval never arrives
Final thin ring versus initial solid disc shows the core was consumed, not decorated
forbiddenInterpretations: generic circle-and-arrow diagram with no visible damage
a person figure literally handing over gifts
smiling crowd or applause rewarding the effort
multiple accents competing — coins and arc share one gold accent, disc holds the teal
a mask or costume being added — this mechanism removes material, never covers it
noveltyIntent: Where prior beats added layers or tilted lines, this one removes mass: the protagonist's own color physically becomes the currency spent, so the audience watches the self get smaller rather than the situation get bigger.
